newsitem.title: UK: CE says has 33.27 pct stake in N. Electric.
newsitem.headline: CE says has 33.27 pct stake in N. Electric.

text.p: CE Electric said on Monday it had secured about 33.27 percent of UK bid target Northern Electric Plc's ordinary shares at the end of last week.
CE, majority-owned by U.S. utility group CalEnergy Co Inc, said it owned or had valid acceptances for some 33.8 million shares of Northern Electric at 1500 GMT on Friday.
Valid acceptances covered about 4.3 million shares, with the rest made up of CE's market purchases under its hostile bid.
CE raised its bid for Northern Electric on Friday by 20p per share to 650p, but the UK utility rejected the offer, arguing that it undervalued the company.
CE said the increased offer was its final bid and set a December 20 deadline.
